comparators.note: RFC 8785 canonical JSON of every expected json artifact; equality with the actual value of the same role after UNSEALED pointers (DESIGN §3.1).
Recomputes g_ + SHA-256 of JCS ["profile-mechanism/1",ownerId,slot,stableKey] for the allocations and compares the ids exactly (DESIGN §3.2).
SHA-256 over the exact UTF-8 bytes of every text artifact, stable-id tuple and transport hop, with Node crypto.
The same digest procedure; the Python twin executes it with hashlib over the same bytes.

Closed Result/1 or PureResult shape, complete Report/2 (header, entries in profile-report/2 order, idMap in DESIGN L753 order, refusal diagnostics equal to report.entries) and payload, compared canonically after UNSEALED pointers.

Placements in the DESIGN L565 UTF-16 tuple order with unique sorted relatedAssociationIds, equal to the expected array (the normalize payload placements, the `value` of sortPlacements, or its vendored `placements` role).
The caller-visible input after the call (json canonically, text byte for byte) equals the caller-state artifact, on success and refusal.
Each hop's output bytes equal the profile-c14n/2 UTF-8 bytes of the expected DocumentEnvelope/1 (sealed digest) and each hop's Result/1 equals its expected result.

Per script step: the complete Result/1 or PureResult, history counters, every change event per listener and injected outcomes, with $same/$differs relations to actual earlier steps and UNSEALED pointers only.

rerun the operation on the expected payload envelope (complete: mode retained; same activation and placement intent): status ok, identical envelope and placements, zero report entries, baseRevision = revision = the first revision (Python manifest note; actual role `fixed-point`: the second-run Result/1).

planRecipe cases with an apply artifact also call applyPlan(plan.payload, envelope.tree, envelope) and compare that PureResult (Python manifest note); the closed `plan` PureResult and every expected `apply` PureResult are compared canonically, and an applyPlan case expects `apply` only.

compileProfile (parity sync PS-25, PS-35): the compile PureResult (one per profile artifact, in order, for a variant list) is compared under profile-c14n/2 after each {"$unsealed": reason} marker is replaced by the actual member at the same position, which must exist (CompiledProfile has no wire shape); the compiled-identity (compiled-identities) artifact is compared under profile-c14n/2 with the compiled section 5.1 identity (Python manifest note; actual roles `compile` and `compiled-identity` or `compiled-identities`).
